requested_titles: List of Power Moons in the Metro Kingdom
title: List of Power Moons in the Metro Kingdom
wikitext:
{{construction}} This is a list of the 81 [[Power Moon]]s that can be found in the [[Metro Kingdom]] of ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. {|class="wikitable" text-align="center" !# !Power Moon !Location !Availability |- !1 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 1.png|200px]]
New Donk City's Pest Problem |The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating [[Mechawiggler]] at the New Donk City Hall. |Available from the start. |- !2 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 2.png|200px]]
Drummer on Board! |The player must talk to Mayor Pauline at the New Donk City Hall Plaza, where she will ask Mario to find four musicians so that they can perform in the New Donk City Festival. The drummer can be found in the New Donk City Hall Plaza, to the right of the City Hall entrance. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !3 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 3.png|200px]]
Guitarist on Board! |The player must talk to Mayor Pauline at the New Donk City Hall Plaza, where she will ask Mario to find four musicians so that they can perform in the New Donk City Festival. The guitarist can be found in the park area near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !4 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 4.png|200px]]
Bassist on Board! |The player must talk to Mayor Pauline at the New Donk City Hall Plaza, where she will ask Mario to find four musicians so that they can perform in the New Donk City Festival. The bassist can be found in the Mayor Pauline Commemorative Park on a distant rooftop to the east of the City Hall. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !5 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 5.png|200px]]
Trumpeter on Board! |The player must talk to Mayor Pauline at the New Donk City Hall Plaza, where she will ask Mario to find four musicians so that they can perform in the New Donk City Festival. The trumpeter can be found on top of a triangular-shaped building across from City Hall. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !6 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 6.png|200px]]
Powering Up the Station |The player must defeat the two [[Big Poison Piranha Plant]]s in the New Donk City Power Plant in order to receive this Power Moon. |Available after collecting all 4 Power Moons from the band members. |- !7 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 7.png|200px]]
A Traditional Festival! |The player will receive a Multi Moon upon talking to Pauline at the New Donk City Festival. |Available after collecting the "Powering Up the Station" Power Moon. |- !8 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 8.png|200px]]
Inside an Iron Girder |Along the western side of the city, the player can find a stack of crates blocking the entrance to an iron girder. If the player destroys the crates and enters the iron girder, they can find a Power Moon at the other end. |Available from the start. |- !9 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 9.png|200px]]
Swaying in the Breeze |Near the Heliport checkpoint, the player can find a Power Moon in the air above a swinging girder. |Available from the start. |- !10 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 10.png|200px]]
Girder Sandwich |On the eastern side of the city, the player should look for a Power Moon between two girders. To reach it, Mario must wall jump up the girders to obtain the Moon. |Available from the start. |- !11 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 11.png|200px]]
Glittering Above the Pool |From the New Donk City Hall Rooftop, the player should look for a rooftop pool on a building to the west. To reach it, Mario must perform a long jump from the City Hall Rooftop to land on top of the building with the pool. Finally, the player must bounce off the nearby umbrella to reach the Power Moon high above the pool. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !12 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 12.png|200px]]
Dizzying Heights |The player must climb to the top of the New Donk City Hall, where a Power Moon can be found waiting. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !13 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 13.png|200px]]
Secret Girder Tunnel! |Near the Odyssey, the player must locate a Power Moon hidden inside an iron girder. To access it, Mario must enter the iron girder through an opening on its northern face. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !14 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 14.png|200px]]
Who Piled Garbage on This? |From the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player must bounce off the first taxi to reach the building rooftops to its west. On top of the roofs, the player must reach the western corner and find a pile of glowing garbage. If the player ground pounds the spot under the garbage, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !15 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 15.png|200px]]
Hidden in the Scrap |At the Mayor Pauline Commemorative Park, the player can find a broken piece of the Mechawiggler. If Mario ground pounds this piece, he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !16 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 16.png|200px]]
Left at the Café? |At the Outdoor Café, the player should reach the lower rooftop (below the rooftop pool) and locate a pile of birds on the building. If the player ground pounds the spot in the center of the birds, they will be rewarded with a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !17 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 17.png|200px]]
Caught Hopping on a Building! |At the Rooftop Garden area, the player can find a rabbit hopping around the rooftops. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon. |- !18 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 18.png|200px]]
How Do They Take Out the Trash? |From the New Donk City Hall Rooftop, the player should look for a trash container on top of an iron girder to the east. To reach the container, Mario must long jump from the City Hall Rooftop to the iron girder. Once Mario opens the trash container (by throwing Cappy at it), he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !19 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 19.png|200px]]
Metro Kingdom Timer Challenge 1 |On the western side of the city, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some seesaw-platforms and a Power Moon above them. The player must then use the seesaw-platforms to collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon. |- !20 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 20.png|200px]]
Metro Kingdom Timer Challenge 2 |At the highest point of the New Donk City Hall Rooftop, the player can find a motor scooter and a [[P Switch]]. Mario must jump onto the motor scooter and drive onto the P Switch, which will temporarily reveal a checkered-pathway. The player must then drive across the path and collect the key, which will unlock the cage containing the Power Moon. Finally, Mario must collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon. |- !21 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 21.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Building Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located on top of a building in the south-western corner of the kingdom. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !22 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 22.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Plaza Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located in the north-eastern corner of this park. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !23 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 23.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Rooftop Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located on top of the building next to the Slots mini-game room. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !24 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 24.png|200px]]
How You Doin', Captain Toad? |At the northern end of the kingdom, the player can find Captain Toad on an iron girder. Talking to him will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !25 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 25.png|200px]]
Free Parking: Rooftop Hop |In the north-eastern corner of the kingdom (on top of a building), the player can find a parking space built for motor scooters. If Mario can take the motor scooter located at the Main Street Entrance checkpoint to this parking space, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !26 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 26.png|200px]]
Bench Friends |Near the Crazy Cap Shop, the player can find a lonely New Donker sitting on a bench. If Mario sits next to this man, he will give the player a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !27 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 27.png|200px]]
Shopping in New Donk City |The player can purchase a Power Moon from the [[Crazy Cap]] Shop for 100 yellow [[Coin]]s. |Available from the start. |- !28 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 28.png|200px]]
Metro Kingdom Slots |On the western side of the kingdom, the player can find a building decorated with Tostarena-styled wallpaper. If Mario enters this building, he can play the Slots mini-game. Mario must successfully line up all four Moon icons on the slots to win a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !29 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 29.png|200px]]
Jump-Rope Hero |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find two New Donkers hosting the Jump-Rope mini-game. If Mario can score 30 jumps on this mini-game, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !30 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 30.png|200px]]
Jump-Rope Genius |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find two New Donkers hosting the Jump-Rope mini-game. If Mario can score 100 jumps on this mini-game, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !31 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 31.png|200px]]
Remotely Captured Car |Near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find a New Donker playing with an RC car. Mario must capture the New Donker in order to control the RC car, which the player must steer into the cage with the Power Moon in order to collect it. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !32 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 32.png|200px]]
RC Car Pro! |Next to the "Remotely Captured Car" Power Moon, the player can find a building with the RC Car mini-game. If Mario can complete the mini-game race (three laps in under 35 seconds), he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Remotely Captured Car" Power Moon. |- !33 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 33.png|200px]]
Taking Notes: In the Private Room |On the main street, the player should look for an open building along the left side. Mario must enter this building to find a rainbow-colored treble clef. If the player can collect all the [[Rainbow Note]]s from the treble clef before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !34 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 34.png|200px]]
City Hall Lost & Found |In the New Donk City Hall Interior, the player should look for a hidden treasure chest at the top of the area. Mario must throw Cappy at the chest, which will open it and reveal a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !35 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 35.png|200px]]
Sewer Treasure |In the sewers leading to the Underground Power Plant, the player should look for a hidden ledge along the northern wall, where a Power Moon can be found waiting. |Available after collecting all 4 Power Moons from the band members. |- !36 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 36.png|200px]]
Celebrating In the Streets! |During the New Donk City Festival, the player should look for a hidden [[8-Bit Pipe]] that leads to a secret room containing this Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Powering Up the Station" Power Moon. |- !37 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 37.png|200px]]
Pushing Through the Crowd |At the Outdoor Café, the player must enter the open building on the western side. Inside, Mario can find a lever on the left wall. To activate it, the player must throw Cappy at it. This will temporarily cause a Power Moon to appear at the other end of the room. Mario must collect this Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !38 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 38.png|200px]]
High Over the Crowd |In the area with the "Pushing Through the Crowd" Power Moon, the player should bounce off the awning over the large door at the end of the area in order to reach a hidden platform high above. From this platform, Mario can swing off the three poles to reach a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !39 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 39.png|200px]]
Rewiring the Neighborhood |West of the New Donk City Hall, the player can find a locked door being guarded by a New Donker. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear both the Builder outfit and the Construction hat. Once Mario enters this building, he must reach the end of the area and collect the five [[Moon Shard]]s located here in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !40 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 40.png|200px]]
Off the Beaten Wire |In the area with the "Rewiring the Neighborhood" Power Moon, the player should look for a shiny wooden crate hidden on a side building accessible via the first spark pylon. If Mario destroys this shiny crate, he will receive a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !41 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 41.png|200px]]
Moon Shards Under Siege |On the main street, the player can find a stationary taxi. If Mario captures the taxi, he can use it to drive off to a secret area filled with [[Sherm]]s and five Moon Shards. If the player can collect all five Moon Shards in this area, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !42 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 42.png|200px]]
Sharpshooting Under Siege |In the area with the "Moon Shards Under Siege" Power Moon, the player should look for a hidden metal box located on an iron girder. If Mario uses a Sherm to shoot and destroy this metal box, he will be rewarded with a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !43 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 43.png|200px]]
Inside the Rotating Maze |In the south-western corner of the kingdom (near the Crazy Cap Shop), the player can find a manhole cover on the street. Mario must capture this manhole cover and move it out of the way in order to reveal a hidden entrance below. Within this area, the player must find and collect five Moon Shards, which will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !44 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 44.png|200px]]
Outside the Rotating Maze |In the area with the "Inside the Rotating Maze" Power Moon, the player must backflip to the top of the rotating maze and then head to the northern end of the maze. If Mario jumps off the northern end, he can find a hidden platform containing a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !45 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 45.png|200px]]
Hanging from a High-Rise |In the area with the "Pushing Through the Crowd" Power Moon, the player can find a Warp Pipe at the end of the area. Mario must enter this Pipe to reach a hidden building rooftop, where a Mini Rocket can be found waiting. The player must capture this Mini Rocket and use it to reach a hidden area in the clouds. Mario must traverse through this area in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !46 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 46.png|200px]]
Vaulting from a High-Rise |In the area with the "Hanging from a High-Rise" Power Moon, the player should look for a swing-pole that moves up and down. Mario must ride this pole up to a hidden pole above and use that one to reach yet another moving pole that goes up and down. Finally, the player must use this moving pole to reach a high secret platform where a Power Moon can be found. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !47 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 47.png|200px]]
Bullet Billding |Near the New Donk City Hall Plaza, the player should look for an alleyway with an open building at the end. Mario should enter this building and then traverse to the end of the area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !48 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 48.png|200px]]
One Man's Trash... |In the area with the "Bullet Billding" Power Moon, the player must capture a [[Bullet Bill]] from the first [[Bill Blaster]] and then use it to fly across to a hidden platform with a trash container. If Mario opens the trash container (by throwing Cappy at it), he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !49 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 49.png|200px]]
Motor Scooter: Escape! |Near the New Donk City Hall Plaza, the player should look for a triangular-shaped building with an open doorway. Mario must enter this area and then hop on the motor scooter inside. If the player can ride the motor scooter to the end of the area successfully, they will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !50 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 50.png|200px]]
Big Jump: Escape! |In the area with the "Motor Scooter: Escape!" Power Moon, the player should ride the motor scooter across the top of some wooden crates along the left side in order to find a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !51 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 51.png|200px]]
Secret Path to New Donk City |This Power Moon can be found on the Isolated Rooftop in the south-eastern corner of the kingdom. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: *In the [[Sand Kingdom]], the player should look for the painting located on a tall stone pillar where the "On the Lone Pillar" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom) is located. |Available after collecting the "Showdown on the Inverted Pyramid" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom). |- !52 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 52.png|200px]]
A Tourist in the Metro Kingdom! |After restoring the Sand Kingdom to its former glory, the player should locate the Tostarenan Tourist at the Tostarena Town. Mario must talk to the Tostarenan, who states that he wants to go to the Metro Kingdom. After this conversation, the player should head to the Metro Kingdom, where the tourist can be found next to the Main Street Entrance checkpoint. Talking to him here will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "A Hole in the Desert" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon (Metro Kingdom). |- !53 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 53.png|200px]]
Found with Metro Kingdom Art |On the triangular-shaped building where the trumpeter was found, the player should look for the Hint Art located on a slightly lower ledge facing the City Hall. The Art shows a glowing spot located at the Water Plaza in the [[Lake Kingdom]]. If Mario travels to the Lake Kingdom and ground pounds the spot shown by the Hint Art, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |} {{SMO}} [[Category:Lists|Metro Kingdom Power Moons]] [[Category:Super Mario Odyssey]]

Power Moon. |- !20 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 20.png|200px]]
Metro Kingdom Timer Challenge 2 |At the highest point of the New Donk City Hall Rooftop, the player can find a motor scooter and a [[P Switch]]. Mario must jump onto the motor scooter and drive onto the P Switch, which will temporarily reveal a checkered-pathway. The player must then drive across the path and collect the key, which will unlock the cage containing the Power Moon. Finally, Mario must collect the Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon. |- !21 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 21.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Building Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located on top of a building in the south-western corner of the kingdom. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !22 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 22.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Plaza Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located in the north-eastern corner of this park. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !23 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 23.png|200px]]
City Gardening: Rooftop Planter |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find three seeds. Mario must take one of these seeds to a flower pot located on top of the building next to the Slots mini-game room. After about 4 minutes, the seed will fully sprout into a flower, which will reward the player with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !24 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 24.png|200px]]
How You Doin', Captain Toad? |At the northern end of the kingdom, the player can find Captain Toad on an iron girder. Talking to him will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !25 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 25.png|200px]]
Free Parking: Rooftop Hop |In the north-eastern corner of the kingdom (on top of a building), the player can find a parking space built for motor scooters. If Mario can take the motor scooter located at the Main Street Entrance checkpoint to this parking space, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !26 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 26.png|200px]]
Bench Friends |Near the Crazy Cap Shop, the player can find a lonely New Donker sitting on a bench. If Mario sits next to this man, he will give the player a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !27 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 27.png|200px]]
Shopping in New Donk City |The player can purchase a Power Moon from the [[Crazy Cap]] Shop for 100 yellow [[Coin]]s. |Available from the start. |- !28 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 28.png|200px]]
Metro Kingdom Slots |On the western side of the kingdom, the player can find a building decorated with Tostarena-styled wallpaper. If Mario enters this building, he can play the Slots mini-game. Mario must successfully line up all four Moon icons on the slots to win a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !29 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 29.png|200px]]
Jump-Rope Hero |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find two New Donkers hosting the Jump-Rope mini-game. If Mario can score 30 jumps on this mini-game, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !30 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 30.png|200px]]
Jump-Rope Genius |In the park near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find two New Donkers hosting the Jump-Rope mini-game. If Mario can score 100 jumps on this mini-game, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !31 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 31.png|200px]]
Remotely Captured Car |Near the Main Street Entrance checkpoint, the player can find a New Donker playing with an RC car. Mario must capture the New Donker in order to control the RC car, which the player must steer into the cage with the Power Moon in order to collect it. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !32 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 32.png|200px]]
RC Car Pro! |Next to the "Remotely Captured Car" Power Moon, the player can find a building with the RC Car mini-game. If Mario can complete the mini-game race (three laps in under 35 seconds), he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Remotely Captured Car" Power Moon. |- !33 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 33.png|200px]]
Taking Notes: In the Private Room |On the main street, the player should look for an open building along the left side. Mario must enter this building to find a rainbow-colored treble clef. If the player can collect all the [[Rainbow Note]]s from the treble clef before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !34 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 34.png|200px]]
City Hall Lost & Found |In the New Donk City Hall Interior, the player should look for a hidden treasure chest at the top of the area. Mario must throw Cappy at the chest, which will open it and reveal a Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- !35 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 35.png|200px]]
Sewer Treasure |In the sewers leading to the Underground Power Plant, the player should look for a hidden ledge along the northern wall, where a Power Moon can be found waiting. |Available after collecting all 4 Power Moons from the band members. |- !36 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 36.png|200px]]
Celebrating In the Streets! |During the New Donk City Festival, the player should look for a hidden [[8-Bit Pipe]] that leads to a secret room containing this Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Powering Up the Station" Power Moon. |- !37 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 37.png|200px]]
Pushing Through the Crowd |At the Outdoor Café, the player must enter the open building on the western side. Inside, Mario can find a lever on the left wall. To activate it, the player must throw Cappy at it. This will temporarily cause a Power Moon to appear at the other end of the room. Mario must collect this Power Moon before it disappears. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !38 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 38.png|200px]]
High Over the Crowd |In the area with the "Pushing Through the Crowd" Power Moon, the player should bounce off the awning over the large door at the end of the area in order to reach a hidden platform high above. From this platform, Mario can swing off the three poles to reach a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !39 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 39.png|200px]]
Rewiring the Neighborhood |West of the New Donk City Hall, the player can find a locked door being guarded by a New Donker. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear both the Builder outfit and the Construction hat. Once Mario enters this building, he must reach the end of the area and collect the five [[Moon Shard]]s located here in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !40 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 40.png|200px]]
Off the Beaten Wire |In the area with the "Rewiring the Neighborhood" Power Moon, the player should look for a shiny wooden crate hidden on a side building accessible via the first spark pylon. If Mario destroys this shiny crate, he will receive a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !41 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 41.png|200px]]
Moon Shards Under Siege |On the main street, the player can find a stationary taxi. If Mario captures the taxi, he can use it to drive off to a secret area filled with [[Sherm]]s and five Moon Shards. If the player can collect all five Moon Shards in this area, they will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !42 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 42.png|200px]]
Sharpshooting Under Siege |In the area with the "Moon Shards Under Siege" Power Moon, the player should look for a hidden metal box located on an iron girder. If Mario uses a Sherm to shoot and destroy this metal box, he will be rewarded with a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !43 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 43.png|200px]]
Inside the Rotating Maze |In the south-western corner of the kingdom (near the Crazy Cap Shop), the player can find a manhole cover on the street. Mario must capture this manhole cover and move it out of the way in order to reveal a hidden entrance below. Within this area, the player must find and collect five Moon Shards, which will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !44 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 44.png|200px]]
Outside the Rotating Maze |In the area with the "Inside the Rotating Maze" Power Moon, the player must backflip to the top of the rotating maze and then head to the northern end of the maze. If Mario jumps off the northern end, he can find a hidden platform containing a secret Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !45 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 45.png|200px]]
Hanging from a High-Rise |In the area with the "Pushing Through the Crowd" Power Moon, the player can find a Warp Pipe at the end of the area. Mario must enter this Pipe to reach a hidden building rooftop, where a Mini Rocket can be found waiting. The player must capture this Mini Rocket and use it to reach a hidden area in the clouds. Mario must traverse through this area in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !46 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 46.png|200px]]
Vaulting from a High-Rise |In the area with the "Hanging from a High-Rise" Power Moon, the player should look for a swing-pole that moves up and down. Mario must ride this pole up to a hidden pole above and use that one to reach yet another moving pole that goes up and down. Finally, the player must use this moving pole to reach a high secret platform where a Power Moon can be found. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !47 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 47.png|200px]]
Bullet Billding |Near the New Donk City Hall Plaza, the player should look for an alleyway with an open building at the end. Mario should enter this building and then traverse to the end of the area within in order to receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !48 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 48.png|200px]]
One Man's Trash... |In the area with the "Bullet Billding" Power Moon, the player must capture a [[Bullet Bill]] from the first [[Bill Blaster]] and then use it to fly across to a hidden platform with a trash container. If Mario opens the trash container (by throwing Cappy at it), he will receive a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !49 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 49.png|200px]]
Motor Scooter: Escape! |Near the New Donk City Hall Plaza, the player should look for a triangular-shaped building with an open doorway. Mario must enter this area and then hop on the motor scooter inside. If the player can ride the motor scooter to the end of the area successfully, they will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !50 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 50.png|200px]]
Big Jump: Escape! |In the area with the "Motor Scooter: Escape!" Power Moon, the player should ride the motor scooter across the top of some wooden crates along the left side in order to find a hidden Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |- !51 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 51.png|200px]]
Secret Path to New Donk City |This Power Moon can be found on the Isolated Rooftop in the south-eastern corner of the kingdom. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: *In the [[Sand Kingdom]], the player should look for the painting located on a tall stone pillar where the "On the Lone Pillar" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom) is located. |Available after collecting the "Showdown on the Inverted Pyramid" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom). |- !52 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 52.png|200px]]
A Tourist in the Metro Kingdom! |After restoring the Sand Kingdom to its former glory, the player should locate the Tostarenan Tourist at the Tostarena Town. Mario must talk to the Tostarenan, who states that he wants to go to the Metro Kingdom. After this conversation, the player should head to the Metro Kingdom, where the tourist can be found next to the Main Street Entrance checkpoint. Talking to him here will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "A Hole in the Desert" Power Moon (Sand Kingdom).

Available after collecting the "A Traditional Festival!" Power Moon (Metro Kingdom). |- !53 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Metro Moon 53.png|200px]]
Found with Metro Kingdom Art |On the triangular-shaped building where the trumpeter was found, the player should look for the Hint Art located on a slightly lower ledge facing the City Hall. The Art shows a glowing spot located at the Water Plaza in the [[Lake Kingdom]]. If Mario travels to the Lake Kingdom and ground pounds the spot shown by the Hint Art, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "New Donk City's Pest Problem" Power Moon. |} {|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed navbox mario sm" !colspan=3|
